note: Single source of truth for allowlisted maintenance actions. The hub validates jobs against it (hub/app.py, hub/forge_upkeep.py) and the agent re-validates before running (agent/actions.ps1). lane: system (SYSTEM agent, default) | user (the node user's agent, filtered token; 2.3+). Arg schema: type string|int|bool, required, pattern (full match, case-sensitive), enum, min/max (int), max_len (string), default, not_in. Strings never contain control characters. Every action ends its output with one line '##RESULT <json>'.

actions.name: winget_install
actions.description: Install a package with winget (silent, agreements accepted).

actions.name: winget_upgrade
actions.description: Upgrade one winget package, or all packages when no id is given.

actions.name: npm_global_install
actions.description: npm install -g <package> (machine-wide when run as SYSTEM).

actions.name: restart_task
actions.description: Stop and start a scheduled task.

actions.name: reboot
actions.description: Reboot the machine after a delay (shutdown /r).

actions.name: ensure_task
actions.description: Register (or update) a scheduled task that starts at startup/logon, and start it. User tasks run as the node's configured user (S4U).

actions.name: update_claude
actions.description: Update Claude Code for the machine's user (claude update for the native install, else npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest).

actions.name: update_codex
actions.description: Update the Codex CLI for the machine's user (npm i -g @openai/codex@latest).

actions.name: update_t3
actions.description: Update T3 Code for the machine's user (t3 update).

actions.name: git_sync
actions.description: git fetch --prune, then fast-forward only when the work tree is clean, the branch has an upstream and is not ahead. Never pushes.

actions.name: windows_update
actions.description: Search, download and install Windows updates (Microsoft.Update.Session, as SYSTEM). Never reboots by itself; the hub queues a reboot when one is needed and safe.

actions.name: free_disk
actions.description: Delete temp items untouched for 7 days (Windows and every user's Temp), <work_root>\scratch folders with no file changed in 14 days, and empty every user's recycle bin. Links (junctions, symlinks) are removed, never followed.

actions.name: forge_uninstall
actions.description: Remove Hivemind from this machine: stop and unregister the Forge tasks, remove the firewall rule, delete the Forge folder (keeps data\ when keep_data).
